abstract: Long user behavioral sequences improve the performance of generative recommendation (GR), but computing full attention over long histories during autoregressive beam search decoding incurs substantial online inference latency. To accelerate long-sequence decoding, existing approaches typically rely on static history compression or dynamic top-k sparse attention; however, the former risks losing critical semantics, whereas the latter incurs significant overhead from repeated token selection and non-contiguous memory access. In this work, we thoroughly analyze attention patterns during GR decoding and reveal two key properties: (i) progressive attention focusing, where attention progressively focuses on a small subset of critical historical tokens; and (ii) cross-step ranking consistency, where their importance rankings remain relatively stable across subsequent decoding steps. Motivated by these observations, we propose Progressively Focused Attention (PFA), an efficient sparse decoding framework for long-sequence GR. PFA retains full attention at the initial decoding step to explore global historical preferences. It then establishes a shared importance ranking through cross-beam weighted aggregation and reorders the key-value cache of the selected tokens into a contiguous memory layout. Subsequent decoding steps reuse this ranking and geometrically reduce the token budget, preserving critical semantics while lowering computational and memory access overhead. Extensive experiments on two public benchmarks and a large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate that PFA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. A 7-day online A/B test on a large-scale e-commerce advertising platform further confirms that PFA delivers substantial business gains while maintaining low inference latency. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/PFA-review-088D.
key_ideas:
🔸 观察发现GR解码中注意力自然聚焦：10%的关键token在Step 1后即可覆盖92.98%以上注意力质量，且跨步重要性排序的Spearman相关平均达0.729，支撑早期排序复用。
🔸 三阶段解码：Step 0对完整历史做全注意力；Step 1将各束注意力分布按归一化生成概率加权聚合，得到跨束共享的重要性排序并选出top-k关键token集。
🔸 Step 1时按共享排序一次性重排KV缓存为连续紧凑布局，各束共享；后续步骤（t≥2）直接前缀截断，token预算按几何比率r衰减，消除重复全历史检索与非连续访存。
🔸 Step-aware KV投影：为每个解码步分配独立的K/V投影参数，将复用token映射到各步专属语义子空间，缓解层级SID预测中的表征同质化。
🔸 理论分析表明PFA在典型工业配置下注意力MAC较全注意力加速2.65×、较动态top-k稀疏注意力加速1.99×。
analysis_summary:
🔸 离线评测：在Kindle Store、Tmall和Industry三个数据集上，PFA相对各数据集最强基线平均提升Recall@10约5.75%、NDCG@10约7.18%，且在相同token预算下优于静态压缩方法。
🔸 消融实验显示：动态top-k虽精度与全注意力相当但延迟翻倍（Industry上212ms vs 90ms）；去掉跨束共享或几何缩减均显著增加延迟；去掉step-aware KV投影则明显降低精度。
🔸 共享索引构建时机实验表明Step 1构建在精度与延迟间取得最佳平衡，比Step 0提升Recall@10约3.86%（相对），仅增加7ms延迟。
🔸 超参敏感性：k从384降至256可大幅降低延迟且精度稳定，但k=128时精度明显下降；r从1.00降到0.50延迟下降且精度稳健，r=0.25则精度受损。
🔸 7天在线A/B测试（10%流量）：REV提升3.76%、CTR提升0.34%、GMV提升2.56%，在线RT为11ms，低于直接输入512长度序列的15ms。
personal_view: 基于全文分析，这篇论文的创新点在于将稀疏注意力的设计与生成式推荐束搜索解码的结构特点深度耦合：跨束共享排序、几何预算缩减和连续KV重排三者共同消除了动态top-k的选token和散乱访存开销，属于对解码结构层面优化的细致工作。两个注意力性质的实证分析也提供了扎实的设计动机。实用价值突出，从公开数据集、工业数据到7天线上A/B的完整验证链增强了可信度。可能的局限在于：其收益依赖于GR解码中注意力聚焦这一经验性观察的稳定性，对注意力分布更分散的场景或更长SID可能需重新调参；固定的几何缩减策略与Step 1一次性排序也可能在动态偏好场景下造成信息损失，作者也提到未来需要自适应预算分配。
